author: Zara Rowlands
text: I see what others post and frankly have never had most of these issues.  I had the first one fall off my arm after 4 years and that was because our AC went out at work during a heatwave and by the time I left, I was sweating profusely.  I’ve found that if I put on a new one for several hours before I activate it, I tend to have no issues with function.  I’m also very careful with placing the inserter so it remains flat to my skin.  This ensures that the sensor inserts straight.

author: Pallavi Chaudry
text: I use a cushtie cushion when sleeping on my sides. I place my arm on that to raise my arm up slightly so I’m not lying on the sensor itself. That seems to stop the sensor being squashed & so inaccurate. 🙂
